text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a decent result.
I suppose that's all thanks to my magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I'd like you to be able to handle missions of this level even without my help, though~.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, but you did go to all that effort, right?
I suppose I could praise you a little.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I won't use this plushie as a scapegoat doll either; I'll display it in my room.
Keep fulfilling your duties as my familiar like this!
